In FY2024, the charity maintained a <cite id="3">program expense ratio of 98.6%</cite> to support direct food distribution and medical aid in Pakistan. However, its working capital is limited to just 0.7 months of working capital, leaving its programs vulnerable to financial shocks. The organization reported <cite id="3">$1,727,397 in total revenue in FY2023</cite>, which grew to $2,954,546 in FY2024.
